name: correctness

findings.message: `_cycle_dispatch` emits `stage.start` for every cycle member dispatch where `_cd_iter > 0` without a `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE` guard, so on every fresh cycle-based run each cycle member now emits a `stage.start` event — a change to the event contract the design explicitly prohibited for non-resume paths.

The design decision states the `stage.start` guard in `_cycle_dispatch` must be `if [[ ${_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE:-false} == true ]] && [[ "$_cd_iter" -gt 0 ]]`, but the cycle orchestrator already sets `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=false` here before it ever calls `_cycle_dispatch`, so that proposed guard would suppress `stage.start` for cycle members even during resume — the design decision and the DSPK-1/FSTG-1 requirements are inconsistent with each other, and the implementation silently chose one side (emit always) without resolving the conflict.

The FRSH-2 fresh-run sub-case only asserts that `intake` emits exactly one `stage.start`; it never asserts that cycle members do NOT emit `stage.start` on a fresh run, so the spurious `stage.start` emission introduced by finding 1 passes the guard undetected.
findings.quote: assert_eq "fresh run dispatches intake (not skipped; ADR-050 §6 new-run side)" \

findings.message: When both `resume_mode=true` and `from_stage` is set, `_artifact_persist_restore` is called twice: first inside `_runner_resume_rehydrate` at line ~2897, then again here inside `_runner_from_stage_preflight`. Both failures are silently swallowed (`|| true`), so a git-state-branch read failure leaves the preflight to report "has no restorable primary artifact" with no prior indication of why restoration actually failed.

`pipeline.skip_to_stage` is still emitted on the `--resume --from-stage` path; the original issue identified this event being emitted and nothing acting on it as a bug, and while the fix correctly makes stages skip, the event name still misrepresents what actually occurs now that `_runner_from_stage_preflight` rehydrates artifacts from the git state branch before dispatch.

reason: the correctness lens found a medium or high or critical problem the change introduced
